_howTo: Affiliate product feeds. The source is switched off until a network approves you: see docs/affiliate-setup.md.
One entry per feed. id: short name (lowercase, dashes). store: name shown on the cards. network: rakuten, cj, impact, awin, partnerize or other.
format: csv, tsv or xml (leave it out to detect it). location: ships-to-ontario (default), ontario or sudbury. category: optional, otherwise detected per product.
minDiscountPercent: only products at least this much off (default 10). maxItems: at most this many per feed (default 100).
The feed's URL is NOT stored here (it contains your account credentials). Put it in the GitHub secret AFFILIATE_FEED_URLS as JSON: {"example-store": "https://..."}.
Then set enabled: true in scraper/sources/affiliate-feeds.ts.
